select reportName,roleName,repId from (select I.REPORT_NAME reportName, group_concat(P.ROLE_NAME order by I.REP_ID ,I.REPORT_NAME, I.UPDATE_TIME separator ',') AS roleName, I.REP_ID repId,I.UPDATE_TIME from rep_info I left join rep_power P on P.REPORT_ID=I.REP_ID where 1=1
AND REPORT_NAME LIKE concat_ws('', '%', #{reportName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND I.REPORT_TYPE='Y' group by I.REP_ID , I.REPORT_NAME,I.UPDATE_TIME)temp order by temp.UPDATE_TIME desc
